newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia does not need foreign loans - Mahathir.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia does not need foreign loans - Mahathir.

text.p: Malaysia does not need to seek loans from foreign countries, as there is sufficient money supply in the local market, Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said on Thursday.

The national Bernama news agency quoted Mahathir as saying that there had not been any discussion on the subject during his meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto in Kuala Lumpur on Wednesday.

"We no longer borrow from Japan. As you know, we have stopped borrowing because of the problem of the frequent rise in the yen currency, although recently we find that it had declined," Mahathir told a press conference in the northern Malaysian town of Alor Setar.

In March, Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim had criticised Japan for refusing to renegotiate old yen loans which were provided as overseas assistance, but which were made expensive due to a strong yen.
Hashimoto, who was on a two-day official visit to Malaysia, left for Indonesia earlier on Thursday.
